verdict.rationale: Fern offers its own programmatic surfaces for core workflows. The CLI initializes, validates, previews and publishes docs and SDKs, and the private MCP server lets agents read sites, deployments and reader activity. A probe also found an OpenAPI spec at buildwithfern.com/openapi.json, though its scope is unknown. Nothing documents that the API matches everything the UI can do (e.g., Fern Editor or dashboard actions). missing for 10: a documented management/REST API with stated UI parity, API coverage of Fern Editor and dashboard settings, write-side programmatic access to analytics and site configuration, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Fern CLI lets you initialize projects, validate API definitions, preview changes locally, and publish documentation and SDKs.
